answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, idle agents bleed standing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the relic of the next round. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
